signed_distance_field — 3D transform op

• Data kinds: voxel → sdf

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.signed_distance_field(vol, device='cpu', iso=0.5) (to call the implementation directly, import match3d; match3d.signed_distance_field(vol, device='cpu', iso=0.5); from the registry, ops3d.get("signed_distance_field"))

• GPU: this op has a GPU path (device="cuda")

Usage

Occupancy/density voxels → a signed distance field SDF (inside < 0, outside > 0). edt_jfa applied to both sides.

The SDF is an excellent representation for matching (smooth, gradient = normal, 0 isosurface = surface). It is built from the difference of the inside/outside Euclidean distances. GPU native. Converts back and forth voxel↔SDF↔occupancy.

Definition: with occ = vol > iso, d_out = edt_jfa(occ) (distance from each voxel to the nearest occupied voxel, 0 inside the occupied region), d_in = edt_jfa(~occ) (to the nearest unoccupied voxel), and sdf = d_out − d_in. Outside is +distance, inside is −distance (in voxel units, Euclidean). Since the distances are between voxel centres, no voxel becomes 0: occupied voxels on the boundary are −1, adjacent unoccupied voxels are +1 (the 0 isosurface lies between voxels). iso is the density → occupancy threshold (default 0.5; for count density this means "1 point or more"). For an all-occupied or all-empty volume, the distance on the side without seeds saturates at 1e6: all-occupied gives −1e6, all-empty gives +1e6 (no exception). Returns (D,H,W) float32 numpy.

Downstream: back with sdf_to_occupancy, surface with voxel_to_mesh(sdf, iso=0.0), normal field with sobel3d.
